dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628.text: The endpoint examples use @Image1 and @Video1. The API does not specify an exclusive spelling.

wan3.0-video.text: API examples use Image 1, Video 1 and Audio 1, numbered separately by media type. This is not an exclusive grammar.

wan3.0-video-prime.text: API examples use Image 1, Video 1 and Audio 1, numbered separately by media type. This is not an exclusive grammar.

wan2.7-r2v.text: The API describes Image 1 and Video 1, numbered separately; a first-frame image is outside that numbering.

wan2.7-r2v-2026-06-12.text: The API describes Image 1 and Video 1, numbered separately; a first-frame image is outside that numbering.

happyhorse-1.1-r2v.text: The API describes ordered image references as [Image 1], [Image 2] and so on.

wan2.6-r2v.text: Use character1, character2 and so on in the combined reference URL order. These native names are plain text in this UI.

wan2.6-r2v-flash.text: Use character1, character2 and so on in the combined reference URL order. These native names are plain text in this UI.

agnes-video-2.5.text: The API describes <Picture 1>, <Audio 1>, <Video 1>, numbered separately in each reference array.

agnes-video-2.5-flash.text: The API describes <Picture 1>, <Audio 1>, numbered separately in each reference array.

kling-4.0-image-to-video.text: The API uses @id, for example @image_1. This adapter assigns image_1, image_2 and so on.
